CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.generate_streamlink_mon(p_form_id integer, p_level integer, p_ctx text, p_seed text, p_allow_hidden boolean DEFAULT false, p_shiny boolean DEFAULT false, p_content_build text DEFAULT 'sl-ref-20261013-227b573'::text, p_hidden_ticket text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  prep jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF p_allow_hidden IS NULL OR p_seed IS NULL THEN
    NULL;
  END IF;
  prep := private.streamlink_generate_prepare(p_form_id, p_level, p_ctx, p_content_build, p_hidden_ticket);
  IF (prep->>'ok') IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' THEN
    RETURN prep;
  END IF;
  RETURN private.streamlink_complete_specimen(
    prep,
    p_shiny,
    (private.streamlink_secure_u32() % 25)::int + 1,
    (private.streamlink_secure_u32() % 2147483647)::int,
    (private.streamlink_secure_u32() % 32)::int,
    (private.streamlink_secure_u32() % 32)::int,
    (private.streamlink_secure_u32() % 32)::int,
    (private.streamlink_secure_u32() % 32)::int,
    (private.streamlink_secure_u32() % 32)::int,
    (private.streamlink_secure_u32() % 32)::int,
    private.streamlink_secure_u32()
  );
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.streamlink_wire_set_enabled(p_enabled boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_enabled IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'wire-switch-null';
  END IF;
  UPDATE private.streamlink_wire_switch
     SET enabled = p_enabled,
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = 1;
  RETURN p_enabled;
END
$function$
